author: lordteddey
body: This doesn't make any sense?  Didn't I wait 6 months to be unbanned? I wrote an email to the support email around 3 weeks ago appealing my infraction and Iron accepted it. Maybe this is some sort of communication error? I've literally gotten unbanned after 6 months, then falsely banned then banned again for no justified reason. I haven't broken any rules since I came back, the last rule I've broken was almost 7 months ago now.

title: Banned again?

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello!

To clear this up as quickly as possibly with you, we have come to a conclusion to reconcile your past and present behaviors, both of which have presented an unacceptable nature which we specifically do not tolerate on our server. To provide an exclamation and protroburance of your recent behaviors, you stated, "I was purposely hitting my team mates to look as if I was hacking" (appeal). This clearly shows that your present nature on this server is no different from the last; explicitly saying that you were trying to make it look like you were cheating is a conclusive example that you have no clear-cut intentions on here except to be a continuous rule-violator, and a nuisance. 

Thus, this is what sealed the deal for you: in compilation with your previous actions, and in diagnostic with your current intentions lead us to believe that you returning to this server will bring nothing but more issues.

Your appeal is denied for the reasons above, and as mentioned below.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
> After discussing your ban, we all voted and agreed that although you have waited 6 months you do not deserve to be appealed based off of your previous infractions and actions.

- Senior Staff Team
